payload.summary: Planned phase 1 of multi-vendor review robustness: schema-derived prompts, coerce-then-validate, one repair retry, per-vendor timeouts through converge(), judgment ingest, raw stdout sidecars, and fast-empty rejection.

decisions.title: Keep the findings schema strict
decisions.rationale: Coerce then validate rather than loosening axis/severity required fields (ri-14).

decisions.title: One repair retry
decisions.rationale: A second constrained rewrite with validator errors; no unbounded re-review.

decisions.title: Per-vendor timeout budget passed through converge()
decisions.rationale: Archive p50 for Claude is 410s against a 300s default that converge() never overrode.

decisions.title: Model-review ingest is judgment
decisions.rationale: evidence_class already exists; ingest defaulted to deterministic and made every LLM finding blockable.
